title: Iconos de UI para Juego Casual de Granja: 16 Elementos de Interfaz Etiquetados en Estilo Consistente
prompt: Generate 16 casual farming-game-style UI interface icons with text labels, keeping the visual style consistent. Icons should include: seeds, watering can, harvest basket, tractor, barn, fertilizer, scarecrow, market stall, chicken coop, cow, wheat field, fruit tree, windmill, storage shed, vegetable garden, and fishing pond.
